name: io.github.MattJeff/cliponit
title: ClipOnIt
description: Turn a long video into short, subtitled, reframed clips: import by URL or file, detect viral moments, auto-reframe on faces, cut silences, subtitles, B-roll, music, emojis, export 9:16 / 16:9 MP4. OAuth sign-in, Pro plan.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: oauth2 (dynamic client registration RFC 7591 + PKCE S256, metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource)
